SharedScene.title: SharedScene
SharedScene.description: Immutable snapshot of the 3D apartment scene configuration, edited object transforms/visibility, and camera poses shared via a short URL parameter (?s=<shareId>). Contains zero PII.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shared snapshot was created.

state.description: Persisted 3D scene settings, finishes, furniture configuration, and object edits map.

camera.description: Saved Orbit and Walk camera poses for restoring the exact viewpoint.

/sharedScenes/{shareId}.description: Publicly readable (by exact unguessable ID only), immutable shared 3D apartment scene snapshots. Listing, updating, and deleting are strictly forbidden.
